claims: Amanda Peet revealed in March 2026 that she was diagnosed with stage I breast cancer in the fall of 2025.
Amanda Peet published an essay for The New Yorker titled "My Season of Ativan".
Amanda Peet shared that she discovered the diagnosis while both of her parents were in hospice care.
Peet had been undergoing regular biannual checkups due to having "dense" and "busy" breast tissue.
A concerning ultrasound before Labor Day 2025 led to a biopsy.
The cancer was described as "hormone-receptor-positive" and "HER2-negative".
A second benign mass was also found.
Treatment involved a lumpectomy and radiation.
Peet reported receiving a "clear scan" in January 2026.
Peet was navigating the death of her father.
Peet's mother passed away in January 2026.
